name: cryptoworldz-bot
description: Official CryptoWorldz Telegram Bot with Diamond Buy Auto SAFE LOCKED service

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check db.js && find src test public -type f -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} +
scripts.check:auto: node --check auto-server.js && find src/auto -type f -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} +
scripts.check:structure: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const forbidden=['apps/cryptoworldz-web-core','apps/oneworldz-hub-central','apps/worldz-sites','master-use-library','media','diagnostics'];for(const p of forbidden)if(fs.existsSync(p))throw new Error('Retired path returned: '+p);if(!fs.existsSync('apps/oneworldz-ecosystem-release'))throw new Error('Canonical static build root missing');const gateway=fs.readFileSync('src/pdc-host.js','utf8');if(/WORLDZ_HOSTS|express\.static|cryptoworldz-web-core/.test(gateway))throw new Error('Retired public-domain fallback gateway returned');const w=fs.readdirSync('.github/workflows').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.yml')||x.endsWith('.yaml'));if(w.some(x=>/^deploy-(oneworldz|cryptoworldz|solworldz|worldz|three)/.test(x)))throw new Error('Legacy static deployment workflow returned: '+w.filter(x=>/^deploy-(oneworldz|cryptoworldz|solworldz|worldz|three)/.test(x)).join(','));"
scripts.verify:web: npm run check:structure && npm run build:ecosystem-release && npm run check:web
scripts.verify: npm run check:structure && npm run check && npm run build:ecosystem-release && npm test && npm run check:web && npm run check:auto
